title: How Much an AI Spokesperson Ad Costs: Plans and Batch Prices
summary: AI spokesperson ads cost a few dollars per clip on self-serve plans, but finished batches cost much more. Compare published plans and batch prices.
body_markdown:
## What the price leaves out


Media spend is a separate line. On its[ad pricing page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/pricing) , Meta says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, and a production or management fee should not be read as including media unless the contract says so. The same page recommends starting with at least $5 for the budget and running it over more than six days. That figure is small, but Meta does enforce a floor: its[minimum budgets help page](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says Ads Manager requires a minimum budget for each campaign or ad set, that it varies by country and objective, and that Ads Manager shows an alert when a budget is too low.


Your team's hours are often the largest hidden cost. Cost per usable ad is the batch price, plus your hours at your own rate, divided by the ads that pass review. For example, if you buy Vidful's $3,495 entry plan and 40 of its 60 videos pass your review, the cost is about $87 per usable ad before your hours. Replace the 40 with your own count after a test batch.


## Rules that add review cost


Rules add review work, and that belongs in the cost per ad. The[FTC's rule on fake reviews and testimonials](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials) , effective October 21, 2024, bans testimonials that misrepresent who gave them. The FTC's questions and answers say the rule has no blanket ban on AI avatars, but an avatar testimonial is prohibited if the underlying testimonial is fake or false. Budget time for a claim review on every script, and write AI scripts as brand statements rather than invented customer stories.


## When a cheaper route is the right one


Self-serve tools fit testing many hooks and angles, when your team has the time to script, render and check each clip. They are the cheapest per clip, but the per-clip price leaves out the work that makes an ad approvable. A managed batch fits when your team's time is the constraint, and the batch price is easier to budget than a stream of credits.


Real creators are a different cost. If the ad has to show genuine product use or a customer's experience, price a creator route instead. Our[guide to what AI UGC costs next to creator UGC](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-ugc-vs-creator-ugc-cost) sets out the per-video figures, and our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) covers the wider production budget.


## Key takeaways


- Self-serve AI presenter tools cost about $1.36 to $11.80 per clip by our arithmetic, before scripting, retakes and review.
- Managed batches publish prices such as €10,000 for 20 ads from Admiral Media and $3,495 a month for 60 videos from Vidful.
- Knowlify, our recommended done-for-you option, starts at $5,000 a month and offers a 90-day guarantee (terms on the site). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.
- Meta media spend is a separate budget with a small but enforced minimum, and no production or management fee includes it unless the contract says so.
- Cost per usable ad is the price plus your hours, divided by the ads that pass review.


## FAQ


### How much does an AI spokesperson video cost per clip?


On published self-serve plans, a 15-second Creatify avatar video works out to about $1.36 by our arithmetic, and UGCMaker sells a finished 10-second video for $6. HeyGen's Avatar IV uses 31 credits a minute, which is about $1.50 per minute on the Creator plan. Retakes and your editing time come on top of these figures.


### How much does a done-for-you AI presenter ad cost?


Published batches vary widely. Admiral Media lists €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds, and Vidful lists $3,495 a month for 60 videos. Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month, so ask for a written quote on the same list of finished ads.


### Is an AI spokesperson ad cheaper than a creator ad?


Per video, usually. The gap narrows once you count scripting, retakes and review, and creator ads are the route for a real customer's experience. Our[AI UGC vs creator UGC cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-ugc-vs-creator-ugc-cost) compares the two routes on price per usable ad.


### Does the Meta ad budget count as part of the production price?


No. Meta says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, and a production or management fee does not include media unless the contract says so. Ads Manager also enforces a minimum budget per campaign or ad set that varies by country and objective. Ask every provider to separate the production fee from the media budget in writing.


### What is the best option for AI spokesperson ads?


Knowlify, our recommended option, if you want finished ads with a person checking each one and optional Meta management. Creatify Studio and Vidful publish managed terms you can compare. Get a written quote from each on the same brief before you choose.
